notes: Present from 9.7; absent from 9.0 builds (live introspection, 2026-10-24).

functions.name: area
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of surface area of the geogrid elements.

functions.name: beta
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of geogrid system beta angle. This is defined as the angle between the element local system x-axis and the material system x-axis. In radians measured counter-clockwise from the element local x-axis.

functions.name: component_id
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the ID of geogrid component id.

functions.name: density
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the density of geogrid elements.

functions.name: depth_factor
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the depth factor at which stresses have been recovered. The depth equals Ft/2 where t is the geogrid element thickness. F values equal to +1.0 or -1.0 correspond to the outer/inner geogrid surface. The outer surface is defined by the positive z-direction of the local geogrid element system. F values of 0.0 corresponds to the geogrid mid-surface. The depth factor can be modified with the \(structure geogrid recover stress\) command.

functions.name: element_type
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the name of the finite-element type used by the geogrid elements. The possible types for geogrid elements are ‘cst’, ‘csth’, ‘dkt’, ‘dkt-cst’, and ‘dkt-csth’.

functions.name: extra
functions.signature: itasca.structure.geogridarray.extra(slot: int) -> array float{geogrid} or float{geogrid,3}
functions.description: Get the geogrid extra data in the given slot as an array. Extra variables accessed by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: force_nodal
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the generalized nodal force acting on the geogrid at each node. The translational and rotational components of node 1 are given first.

functions.name: id
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the ID of geogrid element id.

functions.name: in_group
functions.description: Return geogrid group membership as a Boolean array.

functions.name: local_system
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the local coordinate system of geogrid elements.

functions.name: mark
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the mark flag of geogrid elements.

functions.name: poisson
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the Poisson’s ratio of the elements.

functions.name: pos
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the current position of geogrid elements.

functions.name: pressure
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the uniform pressure acting on the geogrid elements. A positive value acts in the z-direction of the element local system.

functions.name: prop_anis
functions.signature: itasca.structure.geogridarray.prop_anis() -> (membrane: tuple of float, bending: tuple of float)
functions.description: Get the anisotropic material properties. Material-stiffness coefficients c’11, c’12, c’13, c’22, c’23, c’33 are returned for both the membrane and bending stiffnesses in that order. If the element does not have anisotropic properties, zeros are returned.

returns.type: (membrane: tuple of float, bending: tuple of float)

functions.name: prop_ortho
functions.signature: itasca.structure.geogridarray.prop_ortho() -> (membrane: tuple of float, bending: tuple of float)
functions.description: Get the orthotropic material properties. Material-stiffness coefficients c’11, c’12, c’13, c’22, c’23, c’33 are returned for both the membrane and bending stiffnesses in that order. If the element does not have orthotropic properties, zeros are returned.

returns.type: (membrane: tuple of float, bending: tuple of float)

functions.name: prop_type
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the material property type. Possible return values are ‘isotropic’, ‘orthotripc’, and ‘anisotropic’.

functions.name: resultant
functions.signature: itasca.structure.geogridarray.resultant(location: int) -> length 8 tuple of array float{geogrid}
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of stress resultants last calculated for the element at the index \(location\). A \(location\) value of 0 gives the resultant at the element centroid; \(location\) values 1, 2 and 3 give the resultant at the nodes. The components in the return value are: Mx, My, Mxy, Nx, Ny, Nxy, Qx and Qy. Note that stress resultants must be calculated with the \(structure geogrid recover\) command. See also the \(resultant_valid\) method.

functions.name: resultant_valid
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of of the stress resultant validity flag. True indicates that the stress resultant values are valid. False indicates that resultants have not been calculated or that there has been a change since they were last calculated that would invalidate the results.

functions.name: set_density
functions.description: Set the density of geogrid elements.

functions.name: set_extra
functions.signature: itasca.structure.geogridarray.set_extra(slot: int, data: array float{geogrid} or float{geogrid, 3}) -> None
functions.description: Set the geogrid extra data in the given slot with an array. Extra variables set by array must be of type float or vec.

functions.name: set_group
functions.signature: itasca.structure.geogridarray.set_group(membership: array bool{geogrid}, group_name: str, slot=1) -> None
functions.description: Set geogrid group from an array. Where membership True set the corresponding geogrid to be a member of group group_name in the given slot.

functions.name: set_mark
functions.description: Set the mark flag of geogrid elements.

functions.name: set_poisson
functions.description: Set the Poisson’s ratio of the elements.

functions.name: set_pressure
functions.description: Set the uniform pressure acting on the geogrid elements. A positive value acts in the z-direction of the element local system.

functions.name: set_shear_cohesion
functions.description: Set the (shear) coupling spring cohesion strength of the geogrid elements.

functions.name: set_shear_friction
functions.description: Set the (shear) coupling spring friction angle of the geogrid elements.

functions.name: set_shear_stiffness
functions.description: Set the (shear) coupling spring stiffness of the geogrid elements.

functions.name: set_slide
functions.description: Set the large-strain sliding flag. A true value denotes that the large-strain sliding is on.

functions.name: set_slide_tol
functions.description: Set the (shear) coupling spring slide tolerance of the geogrid elements.

functions.name: set_thermal_expansion
functions.description: Set the thermal expansion coefficient of geogrid elements.

functions.name: set_thickness
functions.description: Set the element thickness.

functions.name: set_young
functions.description: Set the Youngs modulus of the elements.

functions.name: shear_cohesion
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the (shear) coupling spring cohesion strength of the geogrid elements.

functions.name: shear_dir
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the direction (unit vector in global system) in which the geogrid elements are being loaded by the coupling spring at each node.

functions.name: shear_disp
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the displacement magnitude in the coupling spring at each node. The coupling spring lies in the tangent plane of the geogrid surface.

functions.name: shear_friction
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of/set the (shear) coupling spring friction angle of the geogrid elements.

functions.name: shear_state
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the yield state of the coupling spring at each node. Return values 1, 2 and 3 denotes never yielded, yielding now, or yielded in the past, respectively.

functions.name: shear_stiffness
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the (shear) coupling spring stiffness of the geogrid elements.

functions.name: shear_stress
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the stress magnitude in coupling spring at each node. The coupling spring lies in the tangent plane of the geogrid surface. The direction in which force is acting is given by the \(shear_dir\) method.

functions.name: slide
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the large-strain sliding flag. A true value denotes that the large-strain sliding is on.

functions.name: slide_tol
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the (shear) coupling spring slide tolerance of the geogrid elements.

functions.name: stress
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the stresses at the current depth factor at the index \(location\). A \(location\) value of 0 gives the stress at the element centroid; \(location\) values 1, 2 and 3 give the stress at the nodes. Stresses are expressed in the global system. Note that compressive stresses are negative.

functions.name: stress_confining
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the confining stress at each node. A negative value is compression. The confining stress is the stress component acting perpendicular to the geogrid surface.

functions.name: stress_prin
functions.description: Get the resolved principal stress at the current depth factor at the index \(location\). A \(location\) value of 0 gives the stress at the element centroid; \(location\) values 1, 2 and 3 give the stress at the nodes. Returns a vector encoded as (minimum, intermediate, maximum). Note that compressive stresses are negative in FLAC3D.

functions.name: stress_valid
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the stress validity flag for the element. True indicates that the stresses last calculated at the current depth factor are valid. Galse indicates that stresses have not been calculated, or that there has been a change that invalidates the last stresses calculated.

functions.name: thermal_expansion
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the thermal expansion coefficient of geogrid elements.

functions.name: thickness
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the element thickness.

functions.name: type
functions.description: Get a NumPy array of the type name of geogrid elements.

functions.name: volume
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the element volume, or surface area times thickness.

functions.name: young
functions.description: Get a Numpy array of the Youngs modulus of the elements. Modifying the value during cycling may be a danger.
